validity.recommendation: no edit needed; keep LengthKnown=32.60 / Diameter=6,8 as recorded
validity.researcher_notes: CLASSIFICATION QUESTION (resolved): this is a genuine relocation onto a NEW alignment, not a mere administrative reroute of existing pipe, so the recorded LengthKnown=32.60 mi / Diameter='6, 8' in should NOT be zeroed. FERC's EA Notice of Availability (Docket CP25-551-000, FR Doc 2026-05271, govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-03-18/pdf/2026-05271.pdf) states Great Basin 'requests authorization to relocate a portion of its existing Gabbs Lateral pipeline in Mineral and Nye Counties, Nevada due to planned expansion of the [Naval Air Station Fallon] training range complex,' and would 'install approximately 32.6 miles of pipeline and abandon approximately 21.2 miles of pipeline' -- itemized as construction of about 18.8 mi new 8-inch and 13.8 mi new 6-inch pipe (=32.6 mi total, matching the sheet exactly), and abandonment of about 5.4 mi existing 8-inch and 15.8 mi existing 6-inch pipe. Great Basin's own project portal (gabbsfnas.greatbasingtcprojects.com) independently corroborates the same 32.6 mi / 6-in(13.8mi) + 8-in(18.8mi) new-pipe figures, and adds that 'the new pipeline installation will occur in mostly undisturbed areas on Bureau of Land Management (BLM) lands, while the abandonment will occur in areas that were previously disturbed during the original pipeline installation in 1964' -- i.e. a genuinely new corridor, not a re-lay of the same trench. Two distinct publishers (FERC/Federal Register vs. Great Basin's own site) agree: this is real new-build pipe, correctly retained on the sheet. Minor non-material caveat: the two sources give slightly different abandonment-mileage breakdowns by diameter (FERC: 5.4mi 8-in + 15.8mi 6-in = 21.2mi total; company portal: 2.35mi 8-in + 18.50mi 6-in = 20.85mi total) -- both agree the total is ~21 mi and 6-inch pipe dominates the abandonment, but the diameter split differs. This does not affect any GEM-tracked cell (GEM records only the NEW segment's length/diameter, which both sources agree on exactly), so no `contested` value is proposed. Also note a minor schedule-granularity variance addressed in the Construction/Start fills below (not a data conflict). Project background: pre-filing scoping opened under Docket PF24-6-000 (Notice of Scoping Period, Oct 9, 2024); formal CPCN application filed Sept 29, 2025 in Docket CP25-551-000 pursuant to NGA Sections 7(b)/7(c); EA schedule notice Nov 24, 2025 (FR Doc 2025-20674, EA issuance scheduled for March 13, 2026 -- met exactly); EA Notice of Availability issued March 13/published March 18, 2026 (comment period closed April 13, 2026); no FERC certificate/order found in the Federal Register as of 2026-09-14 (checked via the Federal Register API, search terms 'CP25-551' and 'Gabbs Lateral', 2 documents total, most recent March 2026). Status='proposed' remains correct.

cross_row_leads.facts: FERC Docket PF26-5-000 (opened Jan 20, 2026), 'Notice of Scoping Period ... for the Planned 2028 Expansion Project' (FR Doc 2026-08459, published April 30, 2026): Great Basin 'plans to construct and operate natural gas pipeline facilities in Churchill, Humboldt, Lyon, Pershing, Storey, and Washoe counties, Nevada. The 2028 Expansion Project would consist of approximately 195 miles of new 42-inch-diameter pipeline and approximately 15 miles of new 24-inch-diameter lateral pipelines' (=210 mi of new pipe total), plus a new Jungo Road Compressor Station (Humboldt County), a new receipt point adjacent to the existing Opal Valley Receipt Point, and new delivery/meter/pressure-limiting stations. It 'includes the planned abandonment of approximately 142 miles of existing, mostly 1960s-era, 8- and 16-inch-diameter pipeline and the existing Rye Patch and Lovelock Compressor Stations.' This directly bears on P7860's recorded LengthKnown=0 mi / Diameter=blank (currently coded as a capacity-only expansion with no new physical pipe) -- these figures (195 mi of 42-inch + 15 mi of 24-inch new pipe) suggest LengthKnown=0 may be significantly wrong for P7860 if this scoping-stage project is in fact what the sheet's '2028 Expansion' row describes; needs P7860's own researcher to confirm scope match and whether the project has since progressed past scoping (this notice's comment period closed May 27, 2026).

This is the brief's pre-matched EIA 'related' candidate for P7858, but its own docket field is blank ('docket -') and its capacity/cost profile does not match the Gabbs Lateral NASF Relocation (which explicitly adds NO incremental capacity per FERC and Great Basin's own site) -- ruled OUT as a match for P7858.
